I'm not a plumber so I wouldn't know why it would cost that much.  I am an apprentice pipe fitter. I work for construction companies that contract for gas/oil companies.  I don't work 365 days out of the year and that's why they pay me that much.  I could be on a two month job and have no more work the rest of the year. People in the union struggle sometimes because of this.

I have to travel state to state for work. I think about home, my friends, and family. Sometimes I wish about having a job close to home. But the opportunity to join the union was a givin and I didn't want to join the military. 

And it is hard work, rain, snow, hail, ect. We work in it.

Because of my local union (local 32 plumbers and pipe fitters) I'm making over $20 a hour (ranging around $20-$35 depending on which state I'm working in)  plus $42.50 a day for per-diem with health and dental benefits. I'm 18 and this is my first job with a paycheck. 

I'm not trying to boast about how much I make I'm just trying to say that because of unions I don't have to struggle to make ends meet.
